title: Teams, Zoom & meetings
blurb: Can't hear or be heard, camera off, screen share, Teams won't start.

remedies.title: Teams status is stuck (Away, Offline or In a meeting)
remedies.why: Presence follows activity, calendar and other devices; a stuck sign-in or a set status overrides it.

steps.text: Click your picture › Reset status (or set it explicitly), and clear any status duration.
Sign out of Teams on other devices you don't use, then quit and reopen Teams.
Clear Teams' cache.

remedies.title: Teams messages or chats are missing or late
remedies.why: Teams didn't sync, you're in another account/tenant, or the chat is hidden.

steps.text: Check you're in the right organisation (your picture at the top right).
Look under Chat filters for hidden chats.
Clear Teams' cache.
Check in Teams on the web; if it's there, it's this computer's Teams.

remedies.title: Can't join a Zoom meeting
remedies.why: Wrong ID or passcode, an old Zoom app, the host hasn't started, or the network blocks Zoom.

steps.text: Open the link from the invite rather than typing the ID; check the passcode.
"Waiting for host" means it hasn't started yet.
Update Zoom (your picture › Check for Updates).
Try joining from the browser, or on another network.

remedies.title: Background blur or virtual backgrounds don't show
remedies.why: Effects need a recent app and enough computer power; some organisations turn them off.

steps.text: Update the meeting app.
Teams: in the meeting › More › Video effects. Zoom: Settings › Backgrounds & effects.
On a Mac, Control Center › Video Effects adds blur for any app.
On Windows 11 with Studio Effects, Settings › Bluetooth & devices › Cameras offers blur.

remedies.title: Where did my meeting recording go?
remedies.why: Teams saves to OneDrive/SharePoint; Zoom saves locally or to the cloud.

steps.text: Teams: open the meeting chat; the recording link appears there after processing (it's in the organiser's OneDrive › Recordings, or the channel's SharePoint).
Zoom: local recordings in Documents › Zoom; cloud ones at zoom.us › Recordings.
Long meetings can take a while to appear.

remedies.title: Headset mute or answer button doesn't work in calls
remedies.why: Call buttons need the app to support the headset and may need the maker's software.

steps.text: Pick the headset as speaker and microphone in the meeting app (not just the system).
Install the headset maker's app (Jabra Direct, Poly Lens, Logi Tune).
Use the dongle (USB receiver) rather than plain Bluetooth for full call controls.

remedies.title: Can't join another organisation's Teams meeting or team
remedies.why: External meetings may need a guest account or allow anonymous join only from the browser.

steps.text: Open the meeting link and choose "Continue on this browser" to join as a guest.
If you were added as a guest to their team, switch organisations from your picture.
Accept the guest invitation email first.

remedies.title: Turn on live captions or a transcript in meetings
remedies.why: Meeting apps can show live captions, and the system can caption any audio.

steps.text: Teams: More › Language and speech › Turn on live captions. Zoom: Captions button.
Windows Live captions for any audio: Windows+Ctrl+L.
Mac Live Captions: Accessibility › Live Captions.
